title: Queryfirst deployment manifest (version 1)
description: Written by `qf bundle` (default `queryfirst.manifest.json` at the project root) and read by `qf test --manifest <file>` in a deployment, where no source tree exists. Every meta file of the project in one document. Formatting is canonical: keys in the order documented here, 2-space indent, LF, trailing newline; queries sorted by source, so the same metas always give the same bytes.

version.description: Manifest format version. Readers must reject a larger value (written by a newer Queryfirst).

timestamp.description: queryfirst.json's `timestamp`. When "utc", `qf test` checks that the database time zone is UTC (QF048). A queryfirst.json present where `qf test` runs takes precedence.

settings.description: Project settings `qf test` needs without a queryfirst.json. Optional keys are omitted when absent.
